**Best move:** Qxd1+

**Main line:** Qxd1+ Rf1 (best try to block) Qxf1+ Kxf1 Rxd3

**Motif:** fork (the queen on d1 checks the king and attacks the undefended rook)

**Explanation (coaching note):**
When your opponent's piece is undefended AND gives check when captured, that's usually the move. Here, Qxd1+ wins the rook immediately—the white king is in check, so the rook can't escape. After White's forced Rf1 to block, Qxf1+ continues the attack, and Black has won material decisively. Look for undefended pieces that also deliver check; they're often the strongest blows.
